design.factor_level_note: The battery scales and uncertainty intensities below are explicit inputs, not repository defaults and not calibrated recommendations. Stage 12 fixes the campaign levels; any value recorded here is provisional.

design.scope_note: Structural catalog, deterministic period-data support and seed contract. Since stage 13 the campaign runner enumerates its tasks from this document and verifies the regenerated catalog against the identifiers recorded here. The manifest still generates no scenario support: the conditional support is drawn per task from the seed contract below, and its ScenarioSupportID is produced at run time.
